description: This file contains unit tests for the QueryThings class, a component involved in constructing and parsing JSON-based queries in the Eclipse Ditto project. The tests verify immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality semantics of the QueryThings class.

classes.name: QueryThingsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the QueryThings class, including immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that QueryThings instances are immutable and their components are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented for QueryThings.

methods.name: toJsonWithAllFieldsSetV2
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization of a fully populated QueryThings object in version 2 format.

methods.name: toJsonWithAllFieldsSetV1
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization of a fully populated QueryThings object in version 1 format.

methods.name: toJsonWithOnlyRequiredFieldsSetV1
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization of a minimal QueryThings object with only required fields in version 1.

methods.name: toJsonWithOnlyRequiredFieldsSetV2
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization of a minimal QueryThings object with only required fields in version 2.

methods.name: fromJsonWithAllFieldsSetV1
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON with all fields set (V1).

methods.name: fromJsonWithAllFieldsSetV2
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON with all fields set (V2).

methods.name: assertAllFieldsSet
methods.description: Helper method to verify all properties of a QueryThings object are correctly set.

methods.name: fromJsonWithOnlyRequiredFieldsSetV1
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON with only required fields in V1.

methods.name: fromJsonWithOnlyRequiredFieldsSetV2
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON with only required fields in V2.

methods.name: assertMinimal
methods.description: Helper method to verify only minimal fields are set in a QueryThings object.
